_about: Read by check_port_healthcheck.py (the project-configs pre-commit gate, check-project-configs.ps1). A service that publishes a host port must have a healthcheck (compose or its Dockerfile) or a row here. kind 'exception' = a probe would be wrong or impossible for this service; kind 'gap' = it should have one and does not yet - a known debt, recorded so the rule can be on today, removed when the healthcheck lands (the rule refuses a row a render shows is no longer needed). Seeded 2026-10-07 (oh-health) from the renders of every plane with every profile.
